tools.name: search_vitrins
tools.description: Searches public İşinn listings ("vitrin") of service providers in Turkey, such as private tutors, designers, translators, movers, pilates instructors and physiotherapists. Use when the user is looking for a service or a service provider in Turkey. Returns up to 10 listings with title, provider displ

tools.name: get_vitrin
tools.description: Returns the public details of one İşinn listing: full description, location, the provider's stated price, the cover photo URL (image) and the listing URL. Use after search_vitrins when the user wants more detail about a result.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the service categories on İşinn that currently have active listings, with the number of listings in each and the category page URL.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_vitrins" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
